messages.content: Can I report noise complaint to my local council in city of Atlanta?

function.name: get_law_categories
function.description: Retrieves the list of categories within a specified type of law. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

law_type.description: The type of law to be searched.

country.description: The country where the law is applicable.

specific_category.description: Specific category within the type of law (Optional). Default: 'business'

message.content: Yes, you can report a noise complaint to your local council in Atlanta. In the United States, noise complaints are typically handled by the local police department or the city’s code enforcement office. For Atlanta, you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta Police Department or the Atlanta City Code Enforcement office.
message.reasoning: The user asks if they can report a noise complaint to their local council in Atlanta. This is a yes/no question. We can answer directly: Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta Police Department or the local council. No function call needed.
